args.command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, urllib.parse, os
from pathlib import Path

# Get token
cfg = json.loads((Path.home() / ".nanobot" / "config.json").read_text())
token = cfg["channels"]["telegram"]["token"]
chat_id = os.environ.get("NANOBOT_CHAT_ID", "8008274300")

images = [
    ("https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/19/January_2025_Official_Presidential_Portrait_of_Donald_J._Trump.jpg", "Trump 2025 官方就职肖像"),
    ("https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f2/Donald_Trump_official_portrait_%283x4a%29.jpg", "Trump 2017 白宫官方肖像"),
]

for url, caption in images:
    print(f"Downloading: {caption[:30]}...")
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
            img_data = resp.read()
        print(f"  Downloaded {len(img_data)} bytes")
        
        # Send via Telegram sendPhoto
        boundary = "----FormBoundary7MA4YWxkTrZu0gW"
        body = (
            f"--{boundary}\r\n"
            f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="chat_id"\r\n\r\n{chat_id}\r\n'
            f"--{boundary}\r\n"
            f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="caption"\r\n\r\n{caption}\r\n'
            f"--{boundary}\r\n"
            f'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="photo"; filename="trump.jpg"\r\n'
            f"Content-Type: image/jpeg\r\n\r\n"
        ).encode() + img_data + f"\r\n--{boundary}--\r\n".encode()
        
        api_url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{token}/sendPhoto"
        req2 = urllib.request.Request(
            api_url, data=body,
            headers={"Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}"},
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=30) as resp2:
            result = json.loads(resp2.read())
            if result.get("ok"):
                print(f"  ✅ Sent: {caption}")
            else:
                print(f"  ❌ Failed: {result}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ❌ Error: {e}")

print("Done!")
PYEOF
